newsitem.title: USA: Alyeska says Alaska crude throughput cut 30 pct.
newsitem.headline: Alyeska says Alaska crude throughput cut 30 pct.

text.p: Alyeska Pipeline Service Co said on Thursday it cut crude oil throughput on its Trans-Alaska Pipeline by 30 percent due to restricted space at the Port of Valdez.
"We don't have full storage capacity at Valdez," said a pipeline spokeswoman.
A combination of storage tank maintenance and a lack of tankers at Valdez have scaled back storage space from its usual nine million barrels, she said.
The line usually carries about 1.47 barrels-per-day of crude oil from fields in Alaska's North Slope region.
Throughput should return to normal by Saturday, she said.
